# Interface: MatchableRequest

Defined in: [core/contracts/types.ts:7](https://github.com/jterrazz/package-test/blob/main/src/core/contracts/types.ts#L7)

The observed outgoing request, reduced to what contract matchers inspect.
Built once per request by the engine (MSW on api/jobs, the stub backend on
website/mobile) and handed to [ContractRequest.match](ContractRequest.md#match) and to a
[ContractResponder](../type-aliases/ContractResponder.md).
